description:
Estimate the cost of meeting England's mandatory 10% biodiversity net
gain requirement for a development scheme of `scheme_ha` hectares, across
3 procurement routes (off-site habitat bank mosaic, off-site grassland/
heathland, statutory biodiversity credits, priced per unit at two Defra
credits per unit), and the units to buy from a gain site in the same, a
neighbouring or a further authority (spatial risk multiplier 1.0 / 0.75 /
0.5, with this point's authority names). land_type: brownfield /
arable / improved / semi_improved / mixed. England only. Free, no key.
name: estimate_bng_cost
title: Estimate BNG cost
